name: craft-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog and WebGL/Three.js effects (craft-layer), plus ui-ux: per-library stack skills (shadcn, ReUI, Aceternity, Astryx, MUI, Tailwind), the WCAG audit, CSS-variable theming with a live colour preview, and the accessibility engineer that applies an audit's fix list. Live component-registry lookups route to the registries' own MCP servers — shadcn's and ReUI's — named in ui-ux's stack skills; this marketplace ships none. Uninstall with /craft-suite:uninstall.
